say:1:1621716001:1.text: Sorry, Girod... You wouldn't have been fired if we'd been more careful.
say:1:1621716001:1.source_cn: 吉罗德……对不起，都怪我们不小心，害得你被辞退了。

say:2:1621716002:1.text: That scum only fired you to cover up his fault! You're a good guy!
say:2:1621716002:1.source_cn: 那个大坏蛋老板，他肯定是心虚了才辞退你的！你是好人！

say:3:1621716003:1.text: I can give you all my pocket money if you don't have enough to get by!
say:3:1621716003:1.source_cn: 要是没有兼职，生活费不够的话，我可以把零花钱都给你！

say:5:1621716004:1.text: Haha... thanks for the offer, but don't worry about me. My boss and I don't see eye to eye anyway, and I was already planning to quit.
say:5:1621716004:1.source_cn: 哈哈……谢谢，你们的好意我心领了。不过别担心，这件事对...

say:6:1621716005:1.text: Actually, I should be thanking you. I couldn't have exposed him and gathered solid evidence without your help.
say:6:1621716005:1.source_cn: 今天这件事，我还要谢谢你们呢。感谢你们配合我拆穿了老板...

say:7:1621716006:1.text: I'll report him and make sure he gets the punishment he deserves.
say:7:1621716006:1.source_cn: 准备举报材料的事就交给我吧，我一定会让他得到应有的教训。

say:8:1621716007:1.text: How about we go out for lunch to celebrate?
say:8:1621716007:1.source_cn: 为了庆祝我们的作战计划圆满成功，中午一起去附近吃个午餐...

say:9:1621716008:1.source_cn: 好啊好啊！这顿我们请客！
